format: 8-bit grayscale PNG; pixel value is class ID, not display brightness
method: Manually guided region polygons and strokes; OpenCV GrabCut with two iterations for cabinet, wall, trim, fixtures and perch; existing five-iteration bird mask preserved. Cage region uses a manually traced visible surface envelope.
coverage: Every pixel belongs to exactly one class. No inferred geometry behind the bird.
limitations: Approximate scene-region segmentation, not manually verified pixel-perfect ground truth.
Cage region includes bars, gaps and background seen through the cage envelope; it is not an individual-wire mask.
Other room contents groups unresolved lower-left background objects and any residual pixels.
Cabinet metal fixtures groups the visible curved metal piece, handles and lower support; uncertain object identity is not resolved.
Fine feathers, claws and blurred object boundaries may require manual correction.
